skill_drafts.name: Image Component Optimization
skill_drafts.description: Apply Next.js Image component to optimize images through lazy loading and automatic device-based resizing. Use when rendering images in web applications to reduce load time and improve performance.
contraindications: using static HTML img tags without optimization requirements
image optimization already handled by CDN or external service
static asset serving without dynamic resizing
workflow_steps: Replace native element with Next.js Image component
Specify or allow automatic device-based image resizing
Verify images load and resize correctly across target devices
triggers: displaying images in Next.js pages or components
need responsive image sizing across device types
want to reduce initial page load time
constraints: Image component must be imported from next/image
Device viewport information must be available at render time
Image dimensions should be specified or inferred
cautions: Lazy loading may delay initial image visibility; consider above-the-fold images
Automatic resizing requires browser support for responsive images
output_contract: Images load lazily and automatically resize based on device viewport; page performance metrics improve (reduced initial load time, optimized image delivery)

metadata.prompt: Use the Next.js Image component instead of native tags. The component automatically handles lazy loading and resizes images based on device viewport size. This reduces initial page load and improves rendering performance.

skill_drafts.name: Link Component Prefetching
skill_drafts.description: Use Next.js Link component to prefetch linked pages in the background for faster page transitions. Apply when navigating between pages to improve perceived performance and user experience.
skill_drafts.objective: accelerate page navigation through background prefetching
contraindications: user is on slow or metered connection
intervention_moves: replace native <a> tags with Next.js Link component for internal routes
configure href attribute to target internal page path
allow component to handle prefetching automatically
triggers: need to reduce perceived latency between routes
constraints: Link component must wrap internal routes only
href must point to valid internal page path
prefetching occurs automatically; no manual configuration required
cautions: External links should use standard <a> tags to avoid prefetch overhead
Consider user bandwidth constraints before enabling prefetching at scale
output_contract: Linked pages prefetch in background; page transitions appear instantaneous or near-instantaneous to user

metadata.prompt: Invoke the Link component for internal page navigation. The component automatically prefetches the target page in the background, reducing perceived latency on transition. Ensure the href points to an internal route; external links should use standard <a> tags instead.

skill_drafts.name: Script Loading Control
skill_drafts.description: Use Next.js Script component to manage loading strategy and execution timing of third-party scripts. Prevents blocking the main thread and optimizes script execution order when integrating external scripts.
skill_drafts.objective: control third-party script loading and execution timing
applicable_signals: page interactivity during script load is a concern
contraindications: script is critical for initial page render
using inline scripts that must execute synchronously
script has no external dependencies and must run before page interaction
workflow_steps: Identify the third-party script and its execution requirements
Select appropriate loading strategy (async, defer, or on-demand)
Wrap script in Next.js Script component with chosen strategy
Verify page remains interactive during script loading
Monitor script execution order and dependencies
triggers: need fine-grained control over script execution timing
want to prevent script loading from blocking page render
constraints: Script component must be used instead of native <script> tags for optimization benefits
Loading strategy must be explicitly chosen based on script criticality
cautions: Verify that deferred or async scripts do not cause race conditions with dependent code
Test page interactivity metrics to confirm non-blocking behavior
output_contract: Third-party scripts load asynchronously without blocking the main thread; page remains interactive during script loading; script execution timing is controlled and predictable.

metadata.prompt: Apply the Next.js Script component to third-party scripts. Configure the loading strategy (e.g., async, defer, or on-demand) to ensure scripts do not block page rendering. Verify that the page remains interactive during script loading.
